name: VardyParty Local Service
install: set -e; if [ -f .cursor/install.sh ]; then bash .cursor/install.sh; else bash repos/m3u8-resolver/.cursor/install.sh; fi; if [ -f repos/api/.cursor/install.sh ]; then bash repos/api/.cursor/install.sh; elif [ -f ../api/.cursor/install.sh ]; then bash ../api/.cursor/install.sh; fi; if [ -f repos/client/.cursor/install.sh ]; then bash repos/client/.cursor/install.sh; elif [ -f ../client/.cursor/install.sh ]; then bash ../client/.cursor/install.sh; fi

terminals.name: local-service
terminals.command: if [ -f .cursor/run-service.sh ]; then bash .cursor/run-service.sh; else bash repos/m3u8-resolver/.cursor/run-service.sh; fi

terminals.name: api-dev
terminals.command: if [ -f repos/api/.cursor/run-dev.sh ]; then bash repos/api/.cursor/run-dev.sh; elif [ -f ../api/.cursor/run-dev.sh ]; then bash ../api/.cursor/run-dev.sh; else echo 'api repo not present in this workspace; skipping API preview worker.'; fi
